properties.query: SELECT E.EMP_ID, E.EMP_NAME, E.EMAIL, E.PHONE, D.DEPT_TITLE AS DEPT_NAME, J.JOB_NAME, E.SALARY, E.ENT_YN FROM EMPLOYEE E LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON E.DEPT_CODE = D.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN JOB J ON E.JOB_CODE = J.JOB_CODE ORDER BY E.EMP_ID ASC
